text: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (Quran, Al-Fatihah)
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. (Quran, Al-Fatihah)
It is You we worship and You we ask for help. (Quran, Al-Fatihah)
Guide us to the straight path. (Quran, Al-Fatihah)
Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. (Quran, Al-Baqarah)
Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. (Quran, Al-Baqarah)
O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. (Quran, Al-Baqarah)
And when My servants ask you concerning Me - indeed I am near. (Quran, Al-Baqarah)
Perhaps you dislike a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allah knows, while you know not. (Quran, Al-Baqarah)
And consult them in the matter. (Quran, Ali Imran)
Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. (Quran, Ali Imran)
O you who have believed, persevere and endure. (Quran, Ali Imran)
Indeed, Allah commands you to render trusts to whom they are due. (Quran, An-Nisa)
O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm in justice. (Quran, An-Nisa)
And cooperate in righteousness and piety. (Quran, Al-Ma'idah)
Whoever kills a soul, it is as if he had slain mankind entirely. (Quran, Al-Ma'idah)
Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest. (Quran, Ar-Ra'd)
Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct. (Quran, An-Nahl)
Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life. (Quran, An-Nahl)
And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment. (Quran, Al-Isra)
And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. (Quran, Al-Isra)
Wealth and children are the adornment of worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord. (Quran, Al-Kahf)
And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds. (Quran, Al-Anbiya)
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. (Quran, An-Nur)
And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth in humility. (Quran, Al-Furqan)
And do not turn your cheek in contempt toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. (Quran, Luqman)
Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women... Allah has prepared for them forgiveness and a great reward. (Quran, Al-Ahzab)
O mankind, remember the favor of Allah upon you. (Quran, Fatir)
Say, O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. (Quran, Az-Zumar)
And whose affair is conducted by mutual consultation among them. (Quran, Ash-Shura)
The believers are but brothers. (Quran, Al-Hujurat)
Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. (Quran, Al-Hujurat)
And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me. (Quran, Adh-Dhariyat)
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? (Quran, Ar-Rahman)
He who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed. (Quran, Al-Mulk)
Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or ungrateful. (Quran, Al-Insan)
He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself. (Quran, Al-A'la)
And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion. (Quran, Al-Balad)
For indeed, with hardship will be ease. (Quran, Ash-Sharh)
Indeed, with hardship will be ease. (Quran, Ash-Sharh)
By time, indeed mankind is in loss. (Quran, Al-Asr)
Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience. (Quran, Al-Asr)
Say, He is Allah, [who is] One. (Quran, Al-Ikhlas)
Allah, the Eternal Refuge. (Quran, Al-Ikhlas)
Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. (Quran, Al-Falaq)
Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. (Quran, An-Nas)
Verily, actions are by intentions, and every person will have what they intended. Narrated by Umar bin Al-Khattab. Sahih Muslim.
The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe. Narrated by Abdullah bin Amr. Sahih Bukhari.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself. Narrated by Anas bin Malik. Sahih Bukhari.
Show mercy to others and you will receive mercy. Forgive others and Allah will forgive you. Narrated by Abdullah bin Amr. Sahih Bukhari.
The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth and He who is in the heavens will have mercy upon you. Narrated by Abdullah bin Amr. Sahih Muslim.
Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim. Narrated by Anas bin Malik. Sunan Ibn Majah.
Whoever travels a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise. Narrated by Abu Hurairah. Sahih Muslim.
The most beloved of you to me and the nearest to me in the Hereafter are those with the best character. Narrated by Jabir bin Abdullah. Sunan At-Tirmidhi.
Righteousness is good character. Narrated by An-Nawwas bin Sam'an. Sahih Muslim.
Prayer is light. Narrated by Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari. Sahih Muslim.

If there was a river at the door of any one of you and he bathed in it five times a day, would any dirt remain on him? That is the example of the five prayers with which Allah wipes out sins. Narrated by Abu Hurairah. Sahih Bukhari.

How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all his affairs are good. If something good happens to him, he is grateful, and if something bad happens, he is patient. Narrated by Suhaib. Sahih Muslim.
Every good deed is charity. Narrated by Jabir bin Abdullah. Sahih Bukhari.
Your smile in the face of your brother is charity. Narrated by Abu Dharr. Sahih Muslim.
Be truthful, for truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. Narrated by Abdullah bin Mas'ud. Sahih Muslim.
The pleasure of the Lord is in the pleasure of the parent, and the displeasure of the Lord is in the displeasure of the parent. Narrated by Abdullah bin Amr. Sahih Bukhari.
The believer to another believer is like a building whose different parts enforce each other. Narrated by Abu Musa. Sahih Muslim.

There are two words which are light on the tongue, heavy on the scales: SubhanAllah wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllah al-Azim (Glory be to Allah and praise Him, Glory be to Allah the Almighty). Narrated by Abu Hurairah. Sahih Bukhari.
Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales. Narrated by Abu Hurairah. Sahih Muslim.
If you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much. Narrated by Abu Hurairah. Sunan At-Tirmidhi.
